exercises.prompt: 考虑 $g(x)=x+2$，$h(x)=x^2-4$。a) 求各组合函数方程、画草图、写定义域和值域：i) $f=g+h$；ii) $f=h-g$；iii) $f=g-h$。b) 求 a) 中每个函数的 $f(2)$。

en.prompt: Consider $g(x)=x+2$ and $h(x)=x^2-4$. a) Determine the equation and sketch the graph of each combined function, then state its domain and range: i) $f=g+h$; ii) $f=h-g$; iii) $f=g-h$. b) What is $f(2)$ for each function in a)?

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: a-i) $x^2+x-2=(x+1/2)^2-9/4$: upward parabola with vertex $(-1/2,-9/4)$; $D=\mathbb R$, $R=[-9/4,\infty)$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: a-iii) $-x^2+x+6=-(x-1/2)^2+25/4$: downward parabola with vertex $(1/2,25/4)$; $D=\mathbb R$, $R=(-\infty,25/4]$. b) The values are $4+2-2=4$, $4-2-6=-4$, and $-4+2+6=4$.

en.answer: a) Equations, domains, and ranges are shown in the steps and graph; b) $4,-4,4$.

exercises.prompt: 对原图 a)、b) 中的每对函数，求并画出和函数与差函数的图像，并分别写定义域和值域。原图标签为 a) $f(x)=x^2-3$、$g(x)=-2x+3$；b) $f(x)=\sqrt{x-3}$、$g(x)=-x+2$。
exercises.answer: 和差方程与全部定义域、值域见步骤及解析图。

en.prompt: For each original graph a) and b), determine the equation and graph of $y=(f+g)(x)$ and $y=(f-g)(x)$, and state each domain and range. Labels: a) $f(x)=x^2-3$, $g(x)=-2x+3$; b) $f(x)=\sqrt{x-3}$, $g(x)=-x+2$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: a) Sum: $x^2-2x=(x-1)^2-1$, $D=\mathbb R$, $R=[-1,\infty)$. Difference: $x^2+2x-6=(x+1)^2-7$, $D=\mathbb R$, $R=[-7,\infty)$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: b) Both domains are $[3,\infty)$. Set $t=\sqrt{x-3}\ge0$. The sum is $-t^2+t-1=-(t-1/2)^2-3/4$, so its range is $(-\infty,-3/4]$, attained at $x=13/4$. The difference is $t^2+t+1$, increasing for $t\ge0$, so its range is $[1,\infty)$.

en.answer: See the steps and solution graph for both equations and all domains and ranges.

exercises.prompt: 设 $f(x)=\frac1{x-1}$，$g(x)=\sqrt{x}$。求 a) $(f+g)(x)$；b) $(f-g)(x)$ 的方程，并写各定义域和值域。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: 两者共同定义域 $D=[0,1)\cup(1,\infty)$。a) $h(x)=1/(x-1)+\sqrt{x}$。令 $t=\sqrt{x}$；转折值满足 $(t^2-1)^2=2t$。在 $(0,1)$、$(1,\infty)$ 的唯一根分别记为 $\alpha,\beta$。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: a) 左支连续且趋向负无穷，其最大值 $M=1/(\alpha^2-1)+\alpha\approx-0.788609$；右支两端趋向正无穷，其最小值 $m=1/(\beta^2-1)+\beta\approx2.228705$。所以 $R=(-\infty,M]\cup[m,\infty)$。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: b) $k(x)=1/(x-1)-\sqrt{x}$。在 $x>1$ 连续、严格递减，从正无穷到负无穷，所以仅此分支已覆盖全部实数，$R=\mathbb R$。

en.prompt: Let $f(x)=\frac1{x-1}$ and $g(x)=\sqrt{x}$. Determine the equation, domain, and range of a) $(f+g)(x)$; b) $(f-g)(x)$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: The common domain is $D=[0,1)\cup(1,\infty)$. a) $h(x)=1/(x-1)+\sqrt{x}$. Set $t=\sqrt{x}$; turning values satisfy $(t^2-1)^2=2t$. Let the unique roots in $(0,1)$ and $(1,\infty)$ be $\alpha$ and $\beta$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: a) The continuous left branch tends to negative infinity and has maximum $M=1/(\alpha^2-1)+\alpha\approx-0.788609$. The right branch tends to positive infinity at both ends and has minimum $m=1/(\beta^2-1)+\beta\approx2.228705$. Thus $R=(-\infty,M]\cup[m,\infty)$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: b) $k(x)=1/(x-1)-\sqrt{x}$. On $x>1$ it is continuous and strictly decreasing from positive infinity to negative infinity. This branch alone covers every real value, so $R=\mathbb R$.

exercises.prompt: 生物学家过去 5 年记录农田啮齿动物的出生与死亡。$b(x)=-4x+78$ 为出生数，$d(x)=-6x+84$ 为死亡数，$x$ 是年数；净变化 $P$ 为出生减死亡。a) 写出净变化表达式。b) 假设趋势持续，预测今后 5 年的数量变化。c) 何时开始增加？解释。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: a) $P(x)=(-4x+78)-(-6x+84)=2x-6$。b) 记录结束 $x=5$ 时 $P=4$，到 $x=10$ 时 $P=14$：未来五年都增加，且每年的净增数越来越大；未给初始种群数，不能求绝对种群数量。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: c) $2x-6=0$ 得 $x=3$；$x<3$ 净减少，$x=3$ 持平，$x>3$ 开始净增加。只在模型仍给出合理非负出生与死亡的时间内使用。

en.prompt: A biologist has recorded rodent births and deaths on farmland for the past 5 years. Births are modelled by $b(x)=-4x+78$ and deaths by $d(x)=-6x+84$, where $x$ is time in years. Net population change $P$ is births minus deaths. a) Write an expression for the net change. b) Assuming these rates continue, predict the population behaviour over the next 5 years. c) When does the population start to increase? Explain.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: a) $P(x)=(-4x+78)-(-6x+84)=2x-6$. b) At the end of the records, $x=5$, $P=4$; at $x=10$, $P=14$. The population increases throughout the next five years, with increasing annual net gains. No initial population is given, so an absolute population cannot be calculated.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: c) Solve $2x-6=0$ to get $x=3$. Net change is negative before year 3, zero at year 3, and positive after year 3. Use the model only while births and deaths remain physically meaningful.

en.answer: $P(x)=2x-6$; positive, increasing net gains over the next five years; population increases for $x>3$.

exercises.prompt: 考虑 $g(x)=x+2$ 和 $h(x)=x^2-4$。求并画各组合函数 $f$ 的方程，写定义域、值域和渐近线：a) $f=gh$；b) $f=h/g$；c) $f=g/h$。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: a) $(x+2)(x^2-4)=(x+2)^2(x-2)$，三次曲线，$D=R=\mathbb R$，无直线渐近线；零点 $-2$ 为二重根、$2$ 为单根。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: b) $(x^2-4)/(x+2)=x-2$，但 $x\ne-2$。空洞 $(-2,-4)$，$D=\mathbb R\setminus\{-2\}$，$R=\mathbb R\setminus\{-4\}$；无竖直或水平渐近线。

en.prompt: Consider $g(x)=x+2$ and $h(x)=x^2-4$. Determine the equation and sketch each combined function $f$, then state its domain, range, and any asymptotes: a) $f=gh$; b) $f=h/g$; c) $f=g/h$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: a) $(x+2)(x^2-4)=(x+2)^2(x-2)$ is cubic, $D=R=\mathbb R$, with no linear asymptote; $-2$ is a double zero and $2$ a simple zero.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: b) $(x^2-4)/(x+2)=x-2$, retaining $x\ne-2$. Hole $(-2,-4)$; $D=\mathbb R\setminus\{-2\}$, $R=\mathbb R\setminus\{-4\}$; no vertical or horizontal asymptote.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: c) $(x+2)/(x^2-4)=1/(x-2)$, retaining $x\ne-2,2$. Hole $(-2,-1/4)$; vertical asymptote $x=2$ and horizontal asymptote $y=0$; $R=\mathbb R\setminus\{0,-1/4\}$.

en.answer: a) $(x+2)^2(x-2)$; b) $x-2$, $x\ne-2$; c) $1/(x-2)$, $x\ne\pm2$. Complete graph properties are in the steps.

exercises.prompt: 求第 6 题中各组合函数的 $f(-2)$。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: a) $g(-2)=0$、$h(-2)=0$，积为 $0$。b) 原式是 $0/0$，未定义。c) 原式也是 $0/0$，未定义；不能用约分后的式子代入已排除的输入。

en.prompt: Determine $f(-2)$ for each combined function in #6.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: a) $g(-2)=0$ and $h(-2)=0$, so the product is $0$. b) The original quotient is $0/0$, undefined. c) The original quotient is also $0/0$, undefined. A cancelled expression does not restore the excluded input.

exercises.prompt: 给定 $g(x)=1/(x+4)$，$h(x)=1/(x^2-16)$，求 a) $f=gh$；b) $f=g/h$；c) $f=h/g$ 的方程、定义域和值域。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: 共同原限制为 $x\ne-4,4$。a) $f=1/[(x+4)^2(x-4)]$，$R=\mathbb R\setminus\{0\}$：$x>4$ 给出全部正值，$x<-4$ 给出全部负值。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: b) $f=(x^2-16)/(x+4)=x-4$，$R=\mathbb R\setminus\{-8,0\}$。c) $f=(x+4)/(x^2-16)=1/(x-4)$，$R=\mathbb R\setminus\{0,-1/8\}$。两个被除函数在其定义域上均不为零，没有额外零点限制。

exercises.answer: 三者 $D=\mathbb R\setminus\{-4,4\}$；方程及各值域见步骤。

en.prompt: Given $g(x)=1/(x+4)$ and $h(x)=1/(x^2-16)$, determine the equation, domain, and range of a) $f=gh$; b) $f=g/h$; c) $f=h/g$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: All retain $x\ne-4,4$. a) $f=1/[(x+4)^2(x-4)]$, $R=\mathbb R\setminus\{0\}$: $x>4$ covers all positive values and $x<-4$ all negative values.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: b) $f=(x^2-16)/(x+4)=x-4$, $R=\mathbb R\setminus\{-8,0\}$. c) $f=(x+4)/(x^2-16)=1/(x-4)$, $R=\mathbb R\setminus\{0,-1/8\}$. Neither divisor has a zero on its own domain, so no additional zeros are excluded.

en.answer: All have $D=\mathbb R\setminus\{-4,4\}$; equations and ranges are given in the steps.

exercises.prompt: 对原图每对 $f,g$，求并画出积 $y=(f\cdot g)(x)$ 和商 $y=(f/g)(x)$，写各定义域和值域。a) 图中 $f(x)=x+3$、$g(x)=-x-4$；b) $f(x)=x^2+8x+12$、$g(x)=x+6$。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: b) $f=(x+6)(x+2)$。积 $(x+6)^2(x+2)$，三次函数，$D=R=\mathbb R$。商 $x+2$，但 $x\ne-6$，空洞 $(-6,-4)$；$D=\mathbb R\setminus\{-6\}$，$R=\mathbb R\setminus\{-4\}$。

exercises.answer: 方程、图、定义域和值域均见步骤。

en.prompt: For each original graph, determine the equation and graph of the product $y=(f\cdot g)(x)$ and quotient $y=(f/g)(x)$, and state each domain and range. a) $f(x)=x+3$, $g(x)=-x-4$; b) $f(x)=x^2+8x+12$, $g(x)=x+6$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: a) Product $-(x+3)(x+4)=-(x+7/2)^2+1/4$, $D=\mathbb R$, $R=(-\infty,1/4]$. Quotient $-(x+3)/(x+4)=-1+1/(x+4)$, $D=\mathbb R\setminus\{-4\}$, $R=\mathbb R\setminus\{-1\}$, asymptotes $x=-4,y=-1$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: b) Factor $f=(x+6)(x+2)$. Product $(x+6)^2(x+2)$ is cubic, $D=R=\mathbb R$. Quotient $x+2$, retaining $x\ne-6$; hole $(-6,-4)$, $D=\mathbb R\setminus\{-6\}$, $R=\mathbb R\setminus\{-4\}$.

en.answer: Equations, sketches, domains, and ranges are given in the steps.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: a) $g(-2)=-1$, then $f(-1)=(-1)^2=1$. b) $f(-2)=4$, then $g(4)=5$. The different orders give different results.

en.prompt: For $f(x)=2x^2$ and $g(x)=4/x$, determine and state any restrictions: a) $f(g(x))$; b) $g(f(x))$; c) $g(f(-2))$.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body:
a) $f(g(x))=2(4/x)^2=32/x^2$, with $x
e0$ from the inner function. b) $g(f(x))=4/(2x^2)=2/x^2$, requiring $2x^2
e0$, hence $x

exercises.prompt: 考虑 $f(x)=-2/x$、$g(x)=\sqrt{x}$。a) 求 $y=f(g(x))$。b) 写其定义域和值域。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: a) 将 $\sqrt{x}$ 作为整体代入：$y=-2/\sqrt{x}$。b) 根式要求 $x\ge0$，分母又要求 $\sqrt{x}\ne0$，合并为 $x>0$。所有输出为负，且当 $x$ 从 $0^+$ 到无穷时覆盖所有负数。

en.prompt: Consider $f(x)=-2/x$ and $g(x)=\sqrt{x}$. a) Determine $y=f(g(x))$. b) State its domain and range.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: a) Substitute the whole expression $\sqrt{x}$: $y=-2/\sqrt{x}$. b) The radical requires $x\ge0$ and the denominator requires $\sqrt{x}\ne0$, so $x>0$. Outputs are negative and cover all negative values as $x$ runs from $0^+$ to infinity.

exercises.prompt: 若 $f(x)=2x-5$、$g(x)=x+6$，求 $y=(f\circ g)(x)$，然后画三个函数的草图。

en.prompt: If $f(x)=2x-5$ and $g(x)=x+6$, determine $y=(f\circ g)(x)$, then sketch all three functions.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: $f(g(x))=2(x+6)-5=2x+7$. Plot $f$ through $(0,-5),(1,-3)$; $g$ through $(0,6),(1,7)$; and the composite through $(0,7),(1,9)$. All three domains and ranges are real.

exercises.prompt: 地壳温度 $T=0.01d+20$ 是地表以下深度 $d$（米）的线性函数，$T$ 以摄氏度计。电梯沿竖井以 $5\text{ m/s}$ 下降，写温度关于行进时间 $t$（秒）的函数。

steps.title: 计算与核对
steps.body: 从地表 $d=0$ 出发，$d(t)=5t$ 米。代入得 $T(t)=0.01(5t)+20=0.05t+20$ 摄氏度；$t\ge0$，并限于竖井与线性地温模型有效的范围。

en.prompt: The temperature of Earth’s crust is $T=0.01d+20$, where $T$ is in degrees Celsius and depth $d$ is in metres. An elevator descends a vertical shaft at $5\text{ m/s}$. Express temperature as a function of travel time $t$ in seconds.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: Starting at the surface $d=0$, depth is $d(t)=5t$ metres. Substitute: $T(t)=0.01(5t)+20=0.05t+20$ degrees Celsius, for $t\ge0$ within the shaft and the validity of the linear temperature model.

exercises.prompt: Jolene 买平板电脑，遇一天限定的 25% 折扣，另有减 10 元的优惠券。a) 用原价 $x$ 表示折后价 $d$、用券后价 $c$。b) 求 $c(d(x))$ 并解释。c) 求 $d(c(x))$ 并解释。d) 原价 400 元时哪种方法更便宜？说明。
exercises.answer: 先 25% 折扣，再减 10 元；售价 290 元，比另一顺序少 2.50 元。

en.prompt: Jolene finds a one-day sale of 25% off a tablet computer and also has a 10-dollar coupon. a) Let $x$ be the current price; express discounted price $d$ and coupon price $c$ as functions of $x$. b) Determine and interpret $c(d(x))$. c) Determine and interpret $d(c(x))$. d) For a tablet priced at 400 dollars, which method gives the lower sale price? Explain.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: a) $d(x)=0.75x$, $c(x)=x-10$. b) $c(d(x))=0.75x-10$ applies the discount before the coupon. c) $d(c(x))=0.75(x-10)=0.75x-7.50$ applies the coupon before the discount.

steps.title: Calculate and check
steps.body: d) $c(d(400))=300-10=290$ dollars; $d(c(400))=0.75(390)=292.50$ dollars. Discount first is 2.50 dollars cheaper. If negative prices are prohibited, the first order requires $x\ge40/3$ and the second $x\ge10$; 400 dollars satisfies both conditions.

en.answer: Apply the 25% discount first, then the 10-dollar coupon: 290 dollars, which is 2.50 dollars less.
